dataset: User-provided BGG dataset, 4997 users / 1000 candidate games / 362787 ratings
model: Pure ContentBasedRecommender (mechanics + themes, no popularity score)
split: Validation (80/10/10 split of observed ratings; selection based on validation RMSE)

metric_scope.hit_and_coverage: Same seeded 1000 users sampled from 4479 eligible validation users with at least one held-out rating >= 8

caveats: Unrated games are unlabeled, not known negatives
The candidate catalog is preselected to 1000 popular games, but popularity is not used in recommendation scores
Prior Test was inspected in previous exploratory work; this is validation-only reporting.
Original BGG usernames and rating rows are not part of this output.
